title: FRED Labor Market Dashboard
description: Tracks key U.S. labor market indicators: unemployment rate (U3), broad unemployment (U6), initial jobless claims, continuing claims, nonfarm payrolls, and labor force participation. Rising jobless claims are a leading recession indicator - a sustained move above 250K weekly claims historically precedes downturns. The U3/U6 gap widening signals hidden labor market slack.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'
API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

SERIES = [
    ('UNRATE', 'unemployment_rate_u3', 'Unemployment Rate (U3)', 'pct'),
    ('U6RATE', 'unemployment_rate_u6', 'Unemployment Rate (U6 broad)', 'pct'),
    ('ICSA', 'initial_claims', 'Initial Jobless Claims (weekly)', 'count'),
    ('CCSA', 'continuing_claims', 'Continuing Claims (weekly)', 'count'),
    ('PAYEMS', 'nonfarm_payrolls', 'Total Nonfarm Payrolls (thousands)', 'count'),
    ('CIVPART', 'labor_participation', 'Labor Force Participation Rate', 'pct'),
    ('LNS12300060', 'prime_age_employment', 'Prime-Age (25-54) Employment-Population Ratio', 'pct'),
]

rows = []
for i in range(len(SERIES)):
    series_id = SERIES[i][0]
    label = SERIES[i][1]
    description = SERIES[i][2]
    unit = SERIES[i][3]

    resp = requests.get(
        BASE,
        params={
            'series_id': series_id,
            'api_key': API_KEY,
            'file_type': 'json',
            'sort_order': 'desc',
            'limit': 5,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    obs = resp.json().get('observations', [])

    valid = []
    for o in obs:
        if o.get('value', '.') != '.':
            valid.append(o)

    if not valid:
        continue

    latest = float(valid[0]['value'])
    prev = float(valid[1]['value']) if len(valid) >= 2 else latest
    change = round(latest - prev, 2)

    # Directional signal
    if label == 'initial_claims':
        if latest > 300000:
            signal = 'RECESSION_WARNING'
        elif latest > 250000:
            signal = 'ELEVATED'
        else:
            signal = 'HEALTHY'
    elif label == 'unemployment_rate_u3':
        if latest > 5.0:
            signal = 'HIGH'
        elif latest > 4.0:
            signal = 'RISING'
        else:
            signal = 'LOW'
    else:
        if change > 0:
            signal = 'IMPROVING' if unit == 'pct' and 'participation' in label else 'RISING'
        elif change < 0:
            signal = 'DECLINING'
        else:
            signal = 'UNCHANGED'

    rows.append({
        'series_id': series_id,
        'metric': label,
        'description': description,
        'latest_value': latest,
        'latest_date': valid[0].get('date', ''),
        'prior_value': prev,
        'change': change,
        'unit': unit,
        'signal': signal,
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
